item.title: Build a workflow
item.description:
Workflows are a Pro page for a sequence you run again. First enable Settings → Experimental → Workflows; it is off by default. A block runs code, a code file, a saved HTTP endpoint, an MCP tool, or an OpenAI-compatible model. A decision picks one branch. A loop repeats a frame. The same file is the page and the YAML.

This is separate from a collection runbook, a Markdown runbook, and a repo runbook. Those stay as they are.

item.title: Triggers, runs, and notices
item.description: A workflow runs when you press Run, or when its selected automatic trigger fires. Choose one automatic trigger in Triggers. Switching types keeps each type’s saved settings, but only the selected type starts automatic runs. Older workflows with several configured triggers keep their settings when you choose which one is active. Manual runs stay available in the editor. Triggers run only while Termorq is open. A missed schedule is not replayed. One workflow has one active run. A second start is recorded as Skipped · already running. Two workflows may run at once.
